get.description: Authenticated USER/STAFF/ADMIN. Identical for every caller; no mine overlay or identity fields. states[i] matches geometry.seats[i]: A AVAILABLE, H HELD, S SOLD, B BLOCKED. Background refresh every 750ms for sections requested in the last 30s; snapshot expires 1000ms after observation (not after Redis write). Expired data is never served. Empty/down Redis falls back through bounded PostgreSQL gate. ETag is precomputed on snapshot construction, stored with body in Redis. Client marks its own seats using reservation seatIds (also seats[].id). Reservation transaction remains authoritative; stale A may return 409. GA returns 422.

Create.description: Mutually exclusive shapes. Existing COUNTER requests preserve their existing code path. Seated request derives event/tier/quantity on server.

seatIds.description: Event-scoped event_seats.id values for this reservation. Client derives its own highlighting from this list; empty for COUNTER.

stage.description: Stage bounds [x1,y1,x2,y2], or an empty array when absent.

counts.description: Present for SEATED. Null for GA: do not invent precise COUNTER public availability.

geometryVersion.description: Immutable geometry URL version, null for GA.

SeatReadSectionCounts.description: physical = available+held+sold+blocked; sellable=physical-blocked. Snapshot only, not a promise of hold success.

geometryVersion.description: SHA-256 geometry version; use with the immutable geometry URL.

states.description: Exactly one character per geometry seat, in the same fixed order.

id.description: event_seats.id; pass this opaque event-scoped ID in seatIds. NOT physical seats.id.

mine.description: True only for caller-owned current HELD reservation. No user or reservation identity is exposed.

SeatReadSuggestion.description: Read-only advisory result. Ranking: rowRank, centre distance, first seat number, UUID. Hold may still conflict; no available contiguous run -> 409 NO_ADJACENT_SEATS.

accessible.description: False excludes accessible seats. True requires >=1 accessible seat in the adjacent run; companion seats allowed.

adjacencySegment.description: Seats are adjacent only within the same row and segment; render an aisle at segment boundaries.
